home.heroBody: Custom, handcrafted mates made in Uruguay
home.heroAlt: Handcrafted MateArte mate on a wooden table
home.craftDesktop: We master leatherwork and care for every stage of the process: wrapping, piercing and hand stitching. This is how we create firm, durable mates with a character of their own.
home.craftIntroMobile: Our process begins with mastery of leather, a craft we have refined over many years.
home.craftMobile: In our family workshop, every mate passes through different hands, from wrapping the gourd to piercing and hand stitching. Every piece is finished with attention to the smallest detail.
home.craftHandsAlt: Artisans working on a mate by hand
home.craftLeatherAlt: Detail of leather being worked in the workshop
home.historyDesktop: We began in Paysandú with the Ortiz family. After expanding to Argentina and renewing our identity in 2019, MateArte was born: two workshops, one tradition, and pieces that now travel around the world.
home.historyMobile: It all began in Paysandú, Uruguay, with the Ortiz family. Today, with a presence in Uruguay and Argentina, our products reach both countries and destinations around the world.
home.chooseBody: Unique mates and pieces created with passion, quality and heritage
home.categoryMatesCopy: Imperial, camionero, criollo and torpedo styles.
home.categoryBombillasCopy: In steel and alpaca, with customization options.
home.categoryMaterasCopy: Worked leather made to carry your mate everywhere.
home.categoryTermosCopy: Durable companions for journeys and gatherings.
home.categoryGiftsCopy: Custom products for companies, institutions and events.
home.customBody: Laser engraving, premium hand chasing, bronze appliqués, initials and crests. Customization begins with an idea and is developed together with MateArte.
home.championsDesktop: We create custom pieces for AFA, AUF and football figures who now share our tradition.
home.championsMobile: The quality and customization of our pieces opened the doors to the football world: AFA, AUF and players who now share our tradition.
home.imperialSubtitle: The creators of a name known around the world
home.imperialBody1: It began during Richard's trip to Rivera, where a distinctive handcrafted metal rim sparked an idea. The design was a success, but it still had no name. Then came a suggestion: “Mate Imperial”.
home.imperialBody2: A design born in Uruguay became one of the world's most recognizable and sought-after leather-wrapped gourd mates.
home.imperialAlt: Mate Imperial in leather and worked metal
home.cultureBody: Mate crosses generations, pauses and conversations. MateArte expresses its connection with Uruguay Natural through a craft born and grown in Uruguay.
home.cultureAlt: Mate shared against a Uruguayan sunset
home.storeAlt: Inside the MateArte store in Paysandú
home.shippingBody: From Paysandú to Uruguay and the world. Ask our team about options and delivery times.

aboutPage.metadataDescription: Discover MateArte's family story, its leather and metal craft, and the journey of its handmade pieces from Paysandú to the world.
aboutPage.heroBody: In Paysandú, one family transforms leather and metal into pieces shaped by identity, detail and time.
aboutPage.originBody: The Ortiz family began selling regional goods in Paysandú. Before there was a brand, there was a family space for learning the craft, understanding materials and listening to every customer.
aboutPage.originAlt: Artisan working in the MateArte workshop
aboutPage.riverBody: Production expanded to a new shore in Colón, Entre Ríos. The catalog grew to include thermoses, materas and direct sales, while keeping the work personal and every finish carefully considered.
aboutPage.riverAlt: A person pouring water to prepare mate by the river
aboutPage.brandBody: The project renewed its name and the way it presented itself. MateArte brought tradition and design together in recognizable pieces, with more options to give, personalize and make your own.
aboutPage.brandAlt: MateArte symbol on a leather-colored background
aboutPage.worldBody: Today, the brand's main markets are Uruguay and Argentina. It also works with wholesale and retail customers, preparing every shipment so a piece made here can become part of stories anywhere.
aboutPage.ctaTitle: Quality you can see up close.
